title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Two-map monumental Spaces + fixed frontal camera
preserve: mobile controls cannot trigger text-selection/copy UI

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v15 fixes the Map 1 floating-arch gap by extending supports to the actual visible crown springline, adds masked wall planes behind each arch/support assembly, and changes tower lighting to use full 3D distance including height so upper/far column sections darken naturally.

open_feedback: Review Map 1: supports should visually meet/carry the visible arch with no air gap.
Review Map 1: wall mass should read behind the arch/support figure while the central doorway remains open.
Review Map 2: upper and farther portions of towers should darken from true 3D distance, not only X/Z distance.
Preserve v14 touch swipe and non-selectable mobile controls.
